Location : With a stay at The Blue Horse Inn in Woodstock, you ll be a 1-minute walk from Woodstock Town Hall Theatre and 6 minutes by foot from Red Wagon Toy Company. This bed & breakfast is 14.7 mi (23.7 km) from Killington Resort and 7.7 mi (12.3 km) from Quechee Gorge Bridge.

Rooms : Stay in one of 10 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment.
